name: Test Generator
description: Auto-generates test files when you write new code. Detects your test framework (RSpec, pytest, Jest, Vitest, PHPUnit, Go testing, ExUnit, Rust) and scaffolds comprehensive test suites covering happy path, edge cases, and error handling. A PostToolUse hook reminds you when edited source files lack a corresponding test file, and the /generate-tests command scans your project for untested code. Matches your project's existing test style, uses factories/fixtures, and mocks external dependencies automatically.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, **1 agent**, **1 command** and **1 hook**.

- **Skills** (1): `auto-test` (This skill should be used when the user writes new code, creates a new file, adds a new…)
- **Agents** (1): `test-writer` (Deep test generation agent that analyzes source code and produces comprehensive test suites with edge cases, mocking, and…)
- **Commands** (1): `generate-tests` (Generate test files for source files that lack test coverage)
- **Hooks** (1): `PostToolUse`

Installs with `claude plugin install test-generator@claude-community` from `a-abdellatif98/test-generator`.
